summary: Phase-1 Widgets & Badges Manager — BACKEND PASS (24/24 pytest in test_admin_widgets_badges_phase1.py), FRONTEND MOSTLY PASS with TWO confirmed bugs in AddWidgetPicker on /profile. Admin gate, system seed (16 widgets), widget CRUD (create/dup/patch/launch/disable/delete + system-delete-blocked), /widgets/available filtering, /widgets/disabled admin-only, badge CRUD/assign/recipients/remove/disable/launch/delete and public profile badges all verified end-to-end via API. Frontend: stealth admin sees the page, 16 system rows render with [data-testid=widget-row-{key}], myfeed has no delete button, admin-widgets-tab-{widgets|badges} tabs work, Badges tab shows the OG badge with [data-testid=badges-create], AdminHub card [data-testid=admin-hub-card-widgets] links to /admin/widgets, tftwo (non-admin) is correctly redirected to / when hitting /admin/widgets. BUGS: (1) AddWidgetPicker still shows the disabled 'radar' tile [data-testid=add-widget-radar] even though /api/widgets/available correctly returns only 15 live widgets (verified by direct fetch from the SAME browser session); the picker is falling back to the hard-coded WIDGET_TYPES list. (2) [data-testid=picker-disabled-banner] never renders for stealth even though /api/widgets/disabled returns radar and the user IS recognised as admin (the GET fires from the picker useEffect).

ui_bugs.issue: Picker shows 16 tiles INCLUDING the disabled 'radar' widget after admin disables it. Direct in-browser fetch of /api/widgets/available returns 15 widgets (no radar) using the SAME bearer token, but the picker still renders [data-testid=add-widget-radar]. The picker is using the hard-coded WIDGET_TYPES fallback rather than the API response — most likely the apiClient.get('/widgets/available?placement=profile') call inside the open-effect is throwing or its response shape isn't being read, so setAvailable falls through to the catch branch (setAvailable(WIDGET_TYPES)). Note the SECOND fetch (/widgets/disabled) in the same useEffect DOES succeed and is visible in the network log, so it's specifically the /widgets/available call path that's broken in this component.

[data-testid='picker-disabled-banner'] never appears for stealth even though /api/widgets/disabled returns [{key:'radar',status:'disabled'}] and the conditional only requires disabledKeys.size > 0. Suspect root causes: (a) the useEffect's `cancelled` flag fires before the second await settles (the cleanup runs when the [open, viewer] deps change because viewer hydrates from null→object after mount, racing the fetch). (b) the admin check `viewer?.role === 'admin' || 'founder' || viewer?.username === 'stealth'` may evaluate before viewer is populated and short-circuit via `if(!isAdmin) return` — but since the /widgets/disabled NETWORK call DOES fire (verified in request log), this isn't it; the data is fetched but setDisabledKeys never makes it to render. Recommend: drop the `cancelled` guard on the disabled-keys setState OR move disabledKeys into a separate useEffect that only depends on viewer/open and re-runs whenever viewer changes.

PROFILE.jsx AddWidgetPicker useEffect is fragile: it crams two independent fetches into one async block guarded by a single `cancelled` flag and an `open` dependency, AND a `viewer` dependency. When viewer hydrates async, this effect re-runs and the previous run's cleanup sets cancelled=true, so the second-most-recent fetch's `if(!cancelled)` short-circuit silently drops the result. Split into two effects.

Admin role check in AddWidgetPicker hard-codes username==='stealth' as the admin override. Fine as a belt-and-braces but the real check should be viewer.is_admin from /api/auth/me. Otherwise a renamed founder would lose admin UI affordances.
Badge `OG` previously created by main agent (assigned to tftwo) survived the test run — public /api/profile/tftwo/badges still returns it. Good seed for future runs.

rca of the issue: BUG 1 (radar still in picker): The picker's async useEffect cleanup sets cancelled=true on any [open, viewer] dep change. viewer is loaded async via /api/auth/me, so the picker mounts with viewer=null, the effect runs, viewer hydrates, the effect re-runs, and the previous run's `cancelled=true` causes its `if(!cancelled) setAvailable(reg)` to be skipped — so the picker is stuck showing the catch-branch fallback WIDGET_TYPES (16 items) instead of the API response (15 items). BUG 2 (banner missing): same race — setDisabledKeys is gated by `if(!cancelled)`, the cleanup races the fetch, the state-set is dropped, banner never renders. Reproduction: log in as stealth, disable any widget via /admin/widgets, navigate to /profile, click [data-testid=open-widget-picker]. Mitigation: split the two fetches into separate useEffects and drop the `cancelled` guard on the state-set of disabledKeys (or use AbortController instead so the in-flight request is aborted rather than its result silently dropped).
